sentences.text:
Usman vs State Of Uttarakhand on 3 February, 2026
 High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
 Third Bail Application No.2 of 2026
Usman ........Appellant
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand ........Respondent
Present:-

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Ms. Manisha Bhandari, learned counsel for the applicant through video conferencing.
Mr. B.N. Maulekhi, learned Deputy Advocate General for the State.

Hon'ble Siddhartha Sah, J.
Applicant is in judicial custody in FIR No.0013 of 2020, under Sections 302, 201 and 376 IPC and Section 3(2)(v) of SC, ST Act, Police Station Patel Nagar, District Dehradun.
He has sought his release on short term bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
This is the third bail application.
However, a short term bail application of the applicant has been filed seeking short term bail for a limited period to enable him to attend the marriage of his real brother scheduled on 06.02.2026.
4. Learned counsel for the State was directed to seek instructions.
The State has confirmed about the marriage of the applicant's real brother which is scheduled to be held on 06.02.2026.
5. In view of the above, the Short Term Bail Application (IA No.1 of 2026) is allowed.
6. Without adverting to the merit purely on humanitarian grounds, this Court is of the view that the applicant may be enlarged on short term bail for three weeks' from the date of his release.

7. Accordingly, the applicant shall be enlarged on short term bail for a period of 3 weeks from the date of his release, subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the court concerned.
8. The applicant is directed to forthwith surrender himself after the expiry of the aforesaid period.
9. The short term bail application stands disposed of accordingly.

10. List this case on 17.03.2026.
